label: Macroevolution
text: BI.O.A4.5 Macroevolution. Pattern above the species, read from phylogeny and fossils. It needs no separate mechanism, though rates and constraints differ. The organism biology of fossils is owned here; occurrence in a stratum is EA.O.A3. Mass-extinction tempo is a pattern claim shared by citation with EA.O.A3.

warrant.standard: Phylogeny with support values; congruent independent data
warrant.defeaters: Long-branch attraction; incomplete lineage sorting; horizontal transfer
